text: DSH Skill Lord Serf 为 DSH 提供 Lord 与 Serf 两种多智能体技能：Lord 将复杂项目拆成有边界、依赖、交付物和验收标准的任务包，通过 subagent 派发并审核报告；Serf 按单个任务包执行工作、核对实际产出并提交 REVIEW、BLOCKED 或 CHANGE_REQUEST 报告。Provider 从包内文件目录提供两项技能，支持用户和模型调用，读取时重新加载技能正文，文件变更可刷新目录。适合需要跨代理协作、持续保存项目状态和按证据验收的 DSH 项目。安装为 DSH 插件后无需额外密钥或外部服务。

DSH Skill Lord Serf adds Lord and Serf skills for multi-agent work. Lord plans bounded tasks, dispatches subagents, and reviews reports. Serf executes one task package, checks outputs, and submits a status report. The plugin serves both skills from files; no API key or external service is required.
想让 DSH 把复杂项目拆成可验收的子任务并派给不同代理。
有没有办法让多个子代理按任务包分工协作？
我想为一个持续项目维护任务状态、依赖和评审结果。
让 DSH 代理只执行分配给它的工作，并提交结构化结果。
怎样要求子代理先核对任务边界，再验证实际产出？
我需要一个按报告和证据审核多代理交付的工作流。
希望把协作进度保存在项目文件里，而不是依赖聊天记录。
How can I coordinate DSH subagents with scoped tasks and reviewable reports?
I need an agent to execute one task package, validate its outputs, and submit evidence.
Help me keep project orchestration state in files across sessions.
How do I dispatch bounded work to subagents and review their submissions?
DSH Skill Lord Serf 的功能「项目任务拆分」：Lord 技能将复杂项目拆成带依赖、边界、交付物和验收标准的任务包。适合需要并行协作的项目。
DSH Skill Lord Serf 的功能「Serf 任务执行」：Serf 技能读取并核对指定任务包，只执行分配范围内工作，再提交 REVIEW、BLOCKED 或 CHANGE_REQUEST 报告。
DSH Skill Lord Serf 的功能「技能目录提供」：插件注册 Lord 与 Serf 文件式技能 Provider，列出技能描述并按请求读取正文；文件监听会使目录失效刷新。

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · @ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf：English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin** port of [ttxl314/lord-serf-agent-protocol-SKILL](https://github.com/ttxl314/lord-serf-agent-protocol-SKILL) (protocol 0.5): it ships the `lord` and `serf` skills so DSH can act as the Lord (orchestrator) and as the Serf (executor).

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · The protocol：A file-based multi-agent orchestration protocol with the lifecycle:

```text
plan → package → dispatch → execute → submit → review → decide
```

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · Repository structure：```text
dsh-skill-lord-serf/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle manifest; no runtime deps, peers only
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch layer: registers the plugin row
├── lib/index.js          # cordis plugin: file-backed provider on ctx.skills

Each `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` carries DSH skill frontmatter (`name` + `description`), so one file serves two installation paths:

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · Repository structure：1. **Plugin**: at startup `lib/index.js` registers a file-backed provider on `ctx.skills` (rank 250) exposing both skills with `resourceBase: { kind: 'directory', path: <skill dir> }` in the global layer, available to every session. `get()` re-reads the body on every load, so content edits take effect immediately.
2. **Filesystem**: copy (or link) `skills/lord` and `skills/serf` into `<project>/.dsh/skills/` or `~/.dsh/skills/`; `dsh-skill-filesystem` discovers them without a restart.

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · DSH bindings：| Protocol concept | DSH mechanism |
|---|---|
| Serf executor | `subagent` tool (one subagent per task package) or a separate DSH session |
| Serf sub-work fan-out | `subagent` tool for bounded, disjoint sub-steps inside the task boundary; see `skills/serf/references/dsh-subagents.md` |
| `$serf` invocation | `/serf` user gesture, or a `skill(name='serf')` call inside the dispatched subagent |
| `$lord review <path>` / `$lord resolve <path>` | `/lord` gesture plus the report path; a subagent Serf's final message already reaches Lord |
| State source / packages / reports | Plain workspace files read and written with the filesystem tools |
| Long-running orchestration | DSH goal tools |

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · A. As a bundle (global)：Install from GitHub — this package ships prebuilt ESM, so there is **no build step and no `prepare`-script permission** to grant; pinning a commit is recommended:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf#<commit-sha>
```

Or link a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./dsh-skill-lord-serf
```

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · A. As a bundle (global)：`dsh plugin` adds the package to the profile's dependencies and `dsh.profile.bundles`; the bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml` registers the plugin row. Restart the web service afterwards; the entry then appears in the GUI's Settings → Plugins inventory.

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · B. As filesystem skills (no restart, project-scoped)：```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path .dsh\skills\lord -Target <checkout>\skills\lord
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path .dsh\skills\serf -Target <checkout>\skills\serf
```

The skill watcher picks the catalog up immediately.

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · Self-test：```powershell
node test\self-test.mjs
```

The suite runs 26 checks: provider contract (apply/list/get/invalidate), SKILL.md frontmatter parsing, residual Codex-marker scan, existence of every referenced resource path, compilation of all 6 JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12), positive and negative representative payload validation (including v0.3 field rejection), and template/schema const agreement. It resolves `ajv`, `ajv-formats`, and `yaml` from the local DSH profile (`$DSH_HOME`).

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · Self-test：An end-to-end drill is also supported: Lord creates a schema-validated task package → a `subagent` loads the `serf` skill and executes → the report passes the `micro-review-report`/`submission-envelope` schemas → Lord verifies actual outputs and updates the authoritative state.

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · Differences from upstream：- All `$lord`/`$serf` (Codex commands) → `/lord`/`/serf` (DSH skill gestures).
- `dispatch-instruction`'s `worker_invocation` const is `/serf`; the Invocation section describes DSH `subagent` dispatch; Execution Requirements gained a subagent fan-out clause.
- Added `serf/references/dsh-subagents.md` (DSH-specific Serf fan-out rules) and an "Execution Capabilities (DSH)" section in the coding adapter.
- Removed the Codex-only `agents/openai.yaml`.
- The protocol itself (field names, micro/standard/full task profiles, status vocabulary, report paths, non-negotiables) matches upstream 0.5 exactly, so task packages and reports remain interoperable across platforms.

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · @ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf：[English](README.md) | 中文

将 [ttxl314/lord-serf-agent-protocol-SKILL](https://github.com/ttxl314/lord-serf-agent-protocol-SKILL)（协议 0.5）移植为 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**：提供 `lord` 与 `serf` 两个技能，让 DSH 既可以当 Lord（编排者），也可以当 Serf（执行者）。

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · 协议是什么：以文件为载体的多 Agent 编排协议，生命周期：

```text
plan → package → dispatch → execute → submit → review → decide
```

- **Lord**：规划、任务包（task package）、派发 Serf、权威任务状态（authoritative state source）、评审决策、最终验收。
- **Serf**：执行一个 Lord 下发的任务包、自我校验实际产出、提交一份报告（`REVIEW` / `BLOCKED` / `CHANGE_REQUEST`）。
- 聊天只是通知；项目状态、需求、证据、决策全部落盘为文件（`TASKS.md`、`TASKS/`、`REVIEWS/`、`BLOCKERS/`、`CHANGE_REQUESTS/`）。

dsh-skill-lord-serf/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle 清单；无运行时依赖，仅 peer
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 组合包层：注册 lord-serf 插件行
├── lib/index.js          # cordis 插件：ctx.skills 文件支撑 Provider

`skills/<name>/SKILL.md` 同时带 DSH 技能 frontmatter（`name` + `description`），同一份文件可以双用：

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · 仓库结构：1. **插件方式**：`lib/index.js` 在启动时通过 `ctx.skills.registerProvider` 注册一个文件支撑 Provider（rank 250），把两个技能以 `resourceBase: { kind: 'directory', path: <技能目录> }` 暴露到全局层，所有会话可用；`get()` 每次按需重读正文，编辑即时生效。
2. **文件方式**：把 `skills/lord`、`skills/serf` 复制（或链接）到 `<项目>/.dsh/skills/` 或 `~/.dsh/skills/`，由 `dsh-skill-filesystem` 直接发现，无需重启。

@ttxl314/dsh-skill-lord-serf README · 与 DSH 机制的映射：| 协议概念 | DSH 机制 |
|---|---|
| Serf 执行体 | `subagent` 工具（每个任务包派一个子代理）或独立 DSH 会话 |
| Serf 的子工作扇出 | `subagent` 工具在任务边界内做不相交子步骤；见 `skills/serf/references/dsh-subagents.md` |
| `$serf` 调用 | `/serf` 用户手势，或子代理内 `skill(name='serf')` 加载 |
| `$lord review <path>` / `$lord resolve <path>` | `/lord` 手势 + 报告路径；子代理 Serf 的最终消息直接回到 Lord |
| 状态源 / 任务包 / 报告 | 共享工作区内的普通文件，用 DSH 文件工具读写 |
| 长时间编排 | DSH goal 工具保持目标跨轮次推进 |
